name: Bertrand Mandico
bio: Bertrand Mandico (born 21 March 1971, France) was educated in animation at Gobelins. As an eclectic filmmaker, he incorporates photographs and written elements in his highly personal films. As a long-term project, Mandico is planning to make twenty one short films in twenty one years with actress Elina Löwensohn. His work received multiple awards in international film festivals. The Wild Boys (2017) is his feature debut.

credits.title: Roma elastica
credits.overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

credits.title: Do You See What I See? Cinéma Fantastique Then and Now
credits.overview: Exploring France's rich history of fantasy cinema, this film details the genre from it's foundation to the present.

credits.title: Tableaux d'une explosion
credits.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, a love triangle involves three models under the spell of a demiurge fashion designer. TABLEAUX D'UNE EXPLOSION is a collision, a reinterpretation of the Petrushka tale set to Mussorgsky's music, 'Pictures at an Exhibition'.

credits.title: The Deviant Comedy
credits.overview: Fictional rehearsals for the invisible show: Conann the Barbarian. While a virus ravages the earth, Octavia Foss directs the macabre musical Conann the Barbarian. During rehearsals, the actresses are infected by their characters.

credits.title: Dragon Dilatation
credits.overview: Dragon Dilatation is the union of two filmic essays, Petrouchka and La Déviante Comédie. The first part is a rereading of Stravinsky’s ballet, while the second segment is made up of traces of an unpublished performance rehearsed at the Théâtre des Amandiers.

credits.title: Rainer's Ungodly Camera
credits.overview: While creating SHE IS CONANN, Bertrand Mandico also filmed two short films simultaneously to create an entire "Barbarian Cycle" that brings you deeper into the world that Mandico has created. credits.title: The Show Has Already Started
credits.overview: Histoires courtes, the France 2 program, gives carte blanche to Bertrand Mandico who brings together three of his short films here: Rainer, A Vicious Dog in Skull Valley, Nous les barbares and The Last Cartoon.

credits.title: She Is Conann
credits.overview: Traveling through the abyss, underworld dog Rainer recounts the six lives of Conann, perpetually put to death by her own future, across eras, myths and ages. From her childhood, a slave of Sanja and her barbarian horde, to her accession to the summits of cruelty at the doors of our world.

credits.title: We Barbarians
credits.overview: On the set of a film in the making, four actresses take turns guiding us. They unknowingly drag us into their damnation.

credits.title: Rainer, A Vicious Dog in a Skull Valley
credits.overview: Octavia Foss wants to stage a female version of Conan the Barbarian in the theater. She makes a pact with a dog-headed demon to achieve her goals.

credits.title: J'ai tué Kate Bush
credits.overview: Unused footage of Bertrand Mandico's film "After Blue (Dirty Paradise)," set to new music by Pierre Desprats.

credits.title: The Last Cartoon
credits.overview: The end of the world of humanity as seen by Mandico. A time, as much future as current, where “cinema will be will be all other and nothing else”. credits.title: Nothing Will Be the Same Again
credits.overview: Fragmented memories of a voyeur in 3 chapters: "I grew up" but I’m still falling. "The stalker" who loses his footing. "Memory" and regression.

credits.title: After Blue (Dirty Paradise)
credits.overview: In a faraway future, on a wild and untamed female inhabited planet called After Blue, a lonely teenager named Roxy unknowingly releases a mystical, dangerous, and sensual assassin from her prison.

credits.title: Dead Flash
credits.overview: We see a succession of scattered glam images: beat-up figures on lucid papers and dreamlike landscapes, until the (apelike) apparition of a model and her photographer. Together, they will play martyr and demiurge. They will attempt to achieve grace in a world of moving surfaces.

credits.title: Altered Innocence Vol. 1
credits.overview: A vibrant anthology of LGBTQ+ short films and music videos that delve into the complexities of youth, identity, and desire. credits.title: A Black Sun Sets Upon a Violet Desert
credits.overview: Unseen shots of a “heroic fantasy” film. A modeled model, a cosmic desert, a buried desire.

credits.title: The Return of Tragedy
credits.overview: Two policemen interrupt a secret ceremony: a woman being disembowelled at the bottom of a garden to let out her inner beauty. This situation is presented in a variety of ways and all possibilities are explored.

credits.title: Mandico et le TOpsychoPOR
credits.overview: Bertrand Mandico discovers Topsychopor, a psychological game invented by Topor.

credits.title: ExtaZus
credits.overview: A heroic-fantasy musical.

credits.title: Niemand
credits.overview: A young woman who's had enough of life goes looking for a thrill and ends up face to face with destiny.

credits.title: Ultra Rêve
credits.overview: Three short films, out of the ordinary, brought together under a bewitching and enticing title. They are After School Knife Fight by the duo Poggi/Vinel, Les Îles by Gonzales, and Ultra Pulpe by Mandico. credits.title: À rebours
credits.overview: A man lies on the ground, stabbed. Going backwards (“à rebours”) we will find out what happened shortly before.

credits.title: Knife+Heart
credits.overview: In the summer of 1979, gay porn producer Anne sets out to film her most ambitious film yet, but her actors are picked off, one by one, by a mysterious killer.

credits.title: Love Express. The Disappearance of Walerian Borowczyk
credits.overview: A documentary celebrating the work of Walerian Borowczyk, a director of unparalleled sensitivity, revered in the 1970s, who was later labeled as a maker of erotic movies.

credits.title: Apocalypse After
credits.overview: An abandoned seaside resort. The shooting for a fantasy film about the end of an era wraps up. Two women, both members of the film crew, one an actrice, the other a director, Apocalypse and Joy, are on the verge of concluding their love affair.

credits.title: L'Île aux robes
credits.overview: Visual haiku dealing with still and living life, ghosts and revealing light.

credits.title: Archipelago of the Forgotten
credits.overview: A sunken film by Bertrand Mandico. Never-before-seen shots and sequences from Les Garçons Sauvages.

credits.title: The Wild Boys
credits.overview: Island of La Réunion, in the beginning of the 20th century. Five teenagers commit a savage crime. As punishment, a Dutch captain takes them to a supernatural island with luxuriant vegetation and bewitching powers.

credits.title: Youth
credits.overview: While Koala, the quartermaster, deeply sleeps, Captain Diamand tells the young sailor Luciole about the finest memory of his youth. She was called Cinnamon.

credits.title: Odile of the Valley
credits.overview: Short film about female ecstasy.

credits.title: Depressive Cop
credits.overview: On a Scottish island, a depressed policeman investigates the disappearance of a girl. The mournful mother is responsible for the disappearance of the inhabitants of the island.

credits.title: Our Lady of Hormones
credits.overview: Two actresses rehearse a play during a week-end in a country house. But one of them digs up a strange thing from earth while walking in the woods. A creature the size of a seal, without any holes nor members. The mass of flesh and skin, covered with hair, breathes loudly. The creature becomes an object of lust for both

credits.title: Any Virgin Left Alive?
credits.overview: According to an English legend, Joan of Arc never died at the stake. Her eyes were seared with hot pokers and she was deflowered by an English stud. She was then sentenced to wander on the battlefields, like a vulture, on the look-out for life and searching for any virgins left alive.

credits.title: Préhistoric Cabaret
credits.overview: In Arnarstapi (Iceland), during a cabaret number, a mistress of ceremonies proposes to us a journey into the center of her organs to go and meet the original being. During the journey, the public enters into a trance to reach the ecstasy.

credits.title: Memories of a Boobs Flasher
credits.overview: A boobs flasher tells us, a boobs flasher lets us see.

credits.title: Boro in the Box
credits.overview: A fantasized portrayal of Polish auteur Walerian Borowczyk, Boro discovers a cruel and obscene world. He experiences banal yet colorful adventures, caressing erotic birds and organic cameras in a phantasmagorical alphabet.

credits.title: Living Still Life
credits.overview: In a world in decay, a woman collects her dead animals and restores them to life by filming them  images by image.

credits.title: S... Sa... Salam... Salammbô…
credits.overview: The old Salammbo lives alone on a northern island, in total destitution. Haunted by her memories, Salammbo is mistreated by the phantom of her youth, which sometimes taunts, sometimes bends her back so that she no longer sees the blue of the sky.

credits.title: Next to the volcano
credits.overview: A behind the scenes look at Bertrand Mandico's The Wild Boys, captured by actress Elina Löwensohn on her personal Super 8 camera.

credits.title: Feminism, blast and film
credits.overview: An actress is confronted with her inner demons.

credits.title: The Life and Death of Henry Darger
credits.overview: Henry Darger travels the icy roads of Iceland to find out how much time he has left to live. Two o’clock will tell him a clairvoyant with blue skin.

credits.title: Burlesque and Cold
credits.overview: Enter, so as not to die.

credits.title: His Majesty Little Beard
credits.overview: Three attempts of hypnosis on children.

credits.title: Essai 135
credits.overview: Andreï researches the sonic memory of plants. He has developed a technique for making sounds come back from the past. Andreï wants to keep a tight lid on his discoveries.

credits.title: Mie l’enfant descend du songe
credits.overview: Four paintings. Ode to nature.

credits.title: He Says He's Dead
credits.overview: Hoisted by his rope, a hanged man is lifted up through the branches of a tree. While he is in the middle of his ascent toward the heavens and death, the woman who’d accused him of a crime clears him of it. He gently comes back to life, lying in a field, gazing at everything around him.

credits.title: All You Have Seen Is True
credits.overview: Autobiography fantasized around the manufacturing of a real movie.

credits.title: C’était le chien d’Eddy
credits.overview: Eddie is dead, he remains his dog and an old acquaintance discussing their memories in the forest.

credits.title: Osmose
credits.overview: At the edge of a lake, a couple makes love. A Peeping Tom spies on them.

credits.title: Monsieur Flupersu
credits.overview: Mister Flupersu thinks he has been in touch with an extraterrestrial life. He talks about it, in front of the camera and with the supporting evidences.

credits.title: The Blue Cavalier
credits.overview: The blue horseman, born in the kitchens of hell, escapes and sets off to discover, a strange, dreamlike world. Caught up in all kinds of manipulations, he ends up becoming a legend himself.
